eyebrow: Advanced Platform Engineering, GitOps & CI/CD · Chapter 4
subtitle: Lesson 14 · GitOps in Practice

eyebrow: The Source — where config comes from
code:
apiVersion: source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: GitRepository
spec:
  interval: 1m
  url: https://github.com/acme/gitops-config.git
  ref:
    branch: main
caption: A GitRepository only clones and polls — it deploys nothing by itself.

eyebrow: The Kustomization — what to do with it
code:
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
spec:
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: gitops-config
  path: ./apps/payments-api/overlays/prod
  prune: true
caption: sourceRef links back to the Source; path names the overlay to build and apply.

code:
apiVersion: helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v2
kind: HelmRelease
spec:
  chart:
    spec:
      chart: redis
      version: "19.x"
      sourceRef:
        kind: HelmRepository
        name: bitnami
  values:
    architecture: standalone
caption: The declarative version of helm install/upgrade — chart version and values both live in Git.
